# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 3: Playable Jurchen/Manchu Eight Banners & Shanhaiguan (oe_pmch_, Slot 80). Generated by gen_playable_manchu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Initialize Jurchen/Manchu Eight Banners variables once on host.
oe_pmch_init_host = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_banners } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners value = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_dual_rule } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_dual_rule value = -20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_events_fired } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_events_fired value = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_on value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Bounded adjusters.
oe_pmch_add_banners = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_banners } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners value = 15 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners min = 0 max = 100 }
}

oe_pmch_add_ujen = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha min = 0 max = 4 }
}

oe_pmch_add_dual_rule = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_dual_rule } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_dual_rule value = -20 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_pmch_dual_rule add = $amt$ }
	clamp_variable = { name = oe_pmch_dual_rule min = -100 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Vanilla-verified Great Qing proclamation — STAYS tag = MCH (NEVER switches to non-existent QNG tag!).
oe_pmch_proclaim_great_qing = {
	oe_pmch_init_host = yes
	change_country_name = QNG
	change_country_adjective = QNG_ADJ
	change_country_color = map_QNG
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_qing_dynasty_born value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { owns = location:dadu }
		set_capital = location:dadu
	}
	save_scope_as = oe_pmch_mk_claimant
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
			owns = location:dadu
		}
		international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
			add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_pmch_mk_claimant
			set_leader_country = scope:oe_pmch_mk_claimant
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Situation on_start helper: alerts Manchu host with oe_pmch.8.
oe_pmch_on_pass_started = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		c:MCH = {
			oe_pmch_init_host = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_8 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_8 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.8
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:JEC }
		c:JEC = {
			oe_pmch_init_host = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_8 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_8 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.8
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Biannual O(1) tug-of-war sync during oe_sit_manchu_pass (months 1 & 7).
# Manchu Banners + Ujen Cooha push pass pressure up; Ming/Yuan Guanning + Ningyuan/Funing push pressure down.
oe_pmch_pass_biannual_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_pressure } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure value = 30 }
	}
	# Offense side (MCH or JEC)
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		c:MCH = { oe_pmch_apply_pass_offense_tick = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:JEC }
		c:JEC = { oe_pmch_apply_pass_offense_tick = yes }
	}
	# Defense side (MNG > CHI > YUA)
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MNG }
		c:MNG = { oe_pmch_apply_pass_defense_tick = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
		c:CHI = { oe_pmch_apply_pass_defense_tick = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:YUA }
		c:YUA = { oe_pmch_apply_pass_defense_tick = yes }
	}
	clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope (Manchu contender). Applies 1-year mode = replace Liaoxi siege bonus & pressure delta.
oe_pmch_apply_pass_offense_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_pmch_banners
			var:oe_pmch_banners >= 60
			has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha
			var:oe_pmch_ujen_cooha >= 2
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_pass_offense_high years = 1 mode = replace }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure add = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_pass_offense_base years = 1 mode = replace }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure add = 2 }
	}
}

# Country scope (Central Plains defender). Reads oe_pmng_guanning & Ningyuan/Funing control.
oe_pmch_apply_pass_defense_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:ningyuan_jinzhou
			owns = location:funing
			has_variable = oe_pmng_guanning
			var:oe_pmng_guanning >= 2
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_pass_defense_high years = 1 mode = replace }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure add = -5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				owns = location:funing
				owns = location:ningyuan_jinzhou
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_pass_defense_base years = 1 mode = replace }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure add = -2 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Situation Outcome 1 handler: fires oe_pmch.10 on the conquering Manchu host.
oe_pmch_resolve_conquest_outcome = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		c:MCH = {
			oe_pmch_init_host = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_10 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_10 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.10
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			location:dadu = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
			}
		}
		location:dadu.owner = {
			oe_pmch_init_host = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_10 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_10 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.10
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Situation Outcome 2 handler: Guanning triumph for defender, northern pivot for Manchu.
oe_pmch_resolve_repelled_outcome = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MNG }
		c:MNG = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_ningjin_triumph years = 25 mode = replace } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
		c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_ningjin_triumph years = 25 mode = replace } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		c:MCH = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_northern_pivot years = 15 mode = replace } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:JEC }
		c:JEC = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_northern_pivot years = 15 mode = replace } }
	}
}

# Any scope. Situation Outcome 3 handler: Great Wall Partition & Liaodong Horse-Market Accord.
oe_pmch_resolve_stalemate_outcome = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		c:MCH = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_liaodong_hushi_accord years = 25 mode = replace } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:JEC }
		c:JEC = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_liaodong_hushi_accord years = 25 mode = replace } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MNG }
		c:MNG = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_liaodong_hushi_accord years = 25 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
				add_opinion = { target = c:MCH modifier = oe_pmch_b_liaodong_hushi }
				c:MCH = { add_opinion = { target = c:MNG modifier = oe_pmch_b_liaodong_hushi } }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
		c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_liaodong_hushi_accord years = 25 mode = replace } }
	}
}

# Country scope. O(1) monthly progression & chronological 4-Act event dispatcher on the Jurchen/Manchu host.
oe_pmch_host_tick = {
	oe_pmch_init_host = yes

	# Once per year in January, detect whether a Jurchen unifier controls >= 18 Manchuria locations
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_month = 1
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_jurchen_unifier }
			any_owned_location = {
				count >= 18
				region = region:manchuria_region
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_jurchen_unifier value = 1 }
	}

	# Pace chronological story events at 18-month intervals
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_cd } }
		# Act I (1345-1550)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_1 }
				current_year >= 1345
				current_year <= 1455
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_1 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_2 }
				current_year >= 1450
				current_year <= 1555
				OR = { owns = location:hetu_ala owns = location:fushun_liaoyang owns = location:shenyang }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_2 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.2
		}
		# Act II (1550-1640)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_3 }
				current_year >= 1550
				current_year <= 1610
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_3 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.3
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_4 }
				current_year >= 1585
				current_year <= 1625
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_4 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_5 }
				current_year >= 1600
				current_year <= 1630
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_5 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_6 }
				current_year >= 1618
				current_year <= 1645
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_6 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.6
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_7 }
				current_year >= 1625
				current_year <= 1650
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_7 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.7
		}
		# Act III (Shanhaiguan & Early Qing Consolidation)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_9 }
				is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_manchu_pass
				has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_months
				global_var:oe_pmch_pass_months >= 18
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_9 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.9
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_10 }
				owns = location:dadu
				current_year >= 1620
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_10 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_11 }
				current_year >= 1650
				current_year <= 1710
				OR = { owns = location:dadu num_locations >= 25 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_11 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.11
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_12 }
				current_year >= 1670
				current_year <= 1740
				owns = location:dadu
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_12 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.12
		}
		# Act IV (1685-1800)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_13 }
				current_year >= 1685
				current_year <= 1750
				oe_pmch_has_russian_partner = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_13 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.13
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_14 }
				current_year >= 1720
				current_year <= 1790
				OR = { owns = location:guangzhou owns = location:panyu has_non_rural_port = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_14 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.14
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_15 }
				current_year >= 1750
				current_year <= 1800
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_15 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.15
		}
		# Dynamic late Banner livelihood crisis
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ev_16 }
				current_year >= 1700
				has_variable = oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed
				var:oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed = 1
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_16 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ev_cd value = 1 months = 18 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.16
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Slot 80 master monthly entry point (called by oe_mainline_lock.txt OR oe_pmch_pulse.txt).
# Strictly O(1): prioritizes MCH, then tracked human Jurchen tribe, then JEC (Hetu Ala), then HNE/YEH/ULA.
oe_pmch_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		c:MCH = {
			if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_pmch_host_tick = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_pmch_human_host
			exists = global_var:oe_pmch_human_host
			global_var:oe_pmch_human_host = {
				num_locations >= 1
				oe_pmch_is_host = yes
			}
		}
		global_var:oe_pmch_human_host = { oe_pmch_host_tick = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:JEC }
		c:JEC = {
			if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_pmch_host_tick = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:HNE }
		c:HNE = {
			if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_pmch_host_tick = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:YEH }
		c:YEH = {
			if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_pmch_host_tick = yes }
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Readout & Dev Panel Page 78 Helpers (invoked by gen_dev_mod.py Page 78)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Snapshots live Manchu & oe_sit_manchu_pass telemetry onto ROOT for oe_pmch.90.
oe_pmch_snapshot_readout = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_host value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_banners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_ujen value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_dual value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_qing value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_events value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_manchu_pass }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_sit_state value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_ended }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_sit_state value = global_var:oe_pmch_pass_ended }
		change_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_sit_state add = 10 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_sit_state value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_pressure }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_pressure value = global_var:oe_pmch_pass_pressure }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_pressure value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_months }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_months value = global_var:oe_pmch_pass_months }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_months value = 0 }
	}
	save_scope_as = oe_pmch_reader
	if = {
		limit = { oe_pmch_is_host = yes }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_host value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_banners } set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_banners value = var:oe_pmch_banners } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_ujen value = var:oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_dual_rule } set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_dual value = var:oe_pmch_dual_rule } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed } set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_qing value = var:oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_events_fired } set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_events value = var:oe_pmch_events_fired } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_host value = 2 }
		c:MCH = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_banners } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_banners value = prev.var:oe_pmch_banners } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_ujen value = prev.var:oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_dual_rule } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_dual value = prev.var:oe_pmch_dual_rule } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_qing value = prev.var:oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_events_fired } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_events value = prev.var:oe_pmch_events_fired } } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = c:JEC }
		set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_host value = 3 }
		c:JEC = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_banners } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_banners value = prev.var:oe_pmch_banners } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_ujen value = prev.var:oe_pmch_ujen_cooha } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_dual_rule } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_dual value = prev.var:oe_pmch_dual_rule } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_qing value = prev.var:oe_pmch_qing_proclaimed } } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pmch_events_fired } scope:oe_pmch_reader = { set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_rd_events value = prev.var:oe_pmch_events_fired } } }
		}
	}
}

# Dev Macro 1 (Page 78): Max Eight Banners + Ujen Cooha & start oe_sit_manchu_pass immediately.
oe_pmch_dev_max_banners_start_pass = {
	oe_pmch_init_host = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners value = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_cooha value = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_banners_formed value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_pmch_ujen_ready value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_jurchen_unifier value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_force_start value = 1 }
	remove_global_variable = oe_pmch_pass_ended
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_eight_banners_drill years = 25 mode = replace }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pmch_mod_ujen_cooha_corps years = 25 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_manchu_pass } }
		activate_situation = situation:oe_sit_manchu_pass
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.8
}

# Dev Macro 2 (Page 78): Simulate Shanhaiguan breakthrough & Great Qing proclamation (verifies tag = MCH + QNG name).
oe_pmch_dev_conquest_proclaim_qing = {
	oe_pmch_init_host = yes
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_force_conquest value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_pmch_pass_pressure value = 100 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_pmch.10
}
